study: One actual next-training-dropout own-CE shared-gradient cancellation diagnostic at encountered selected WikiCS checkpoints

input_authority.checkpoint_authority: Actual pinned authoritative COMPLETE_FAMILY.json results; assert all15 seed/arm banks and exact1/1/1/1/4 selected files, then derive24 receipts directly; never infer BASE/N from the previous18-state projection

restoration.owner: Unchanged pinned Family.make(seed,member,baseline,True,members,architecture); object.__new__(Family) supplies actual TRAIN-only state without Family.__init__/fit/run/validation loaders
restoration.state: Each selected receipt restored once, strict model.load_state_dict, actual optimizer.load_state_dict, then original selected streams override fresh make streams; checkpoint step checked against authoritative fit receipt; selection score not used
restoration.parameters: Trainable float32 original model in train mode; original FactorLinear r/s rows and original dropout remain; no parameter value/ownership changes, no running buffers
restoration.RNG: One actual next-training dropout draw from each checkpoint route CPU/CUDA RNG stream; original Family.scope and FactorLinear.member_context; before/after stream hashes retained; no fresh/repeated/matched synthetic draws

own_CE_gradient.loss: L_m = mean over all580 TRAIN labels of native F.cross_entropy for route m, reduction mean; g_m = grad_theta L_m with scale1
own_CE_gradient.shared_route: Exact baseline wrapper native body forward under original route RNG and factor row, select original TRAIN IDs; sequential route forward/backward frees each full graph before the next
own_CE_gradient.single_route: Actual Family.training_outputs(model,streams,False), preserving original boolean TRAIN-mask order and labels
own_CE_gradient.original_shared_objective_relation: mean_m g_m is the Euclidean shared-parameter gradient of original mean own CE (four CE/4 contributions), at this selected state and these sampled route dropouts
own_CE_gradient.no_other_loss: No pooled CE, SupCon, regularization/weight-decay gradient, clipping or optimizer step

parameter_groups.ownership: Registered actual parameter objects; FactorLinear r/s define private row identities; original wrapper.parameter_roles validates native slow/private/shared-builder ownership in each shared bank; no name heuristic assigns ownership

aggregate.all_shared: All atomic shared coordinates including conditional builders; excludes every private r/s row

parameter_groups.inventory: Every actual registered parameter exactly once; retain name,shape,numel,group and ownership. Normalization is retained explicitly. BASE builder groups absent with dimension0.
parameter_groups.coordinates: Fixed named parameter order within each selected shared bank; Euclidean float64 CPU summaries of original float32 gradients. No coordinate cosine across separately trained banks/seeds or genuine bodies.

shared_readouts.scope: BASE/E4/N4 only, within each actual four-route shared bank; report every atomic and aggregate named group
shared_readouts.per_route: Retain squared norm and norm ||g_m||, dimensions, absent/present flag and zero-norm flag
shared_readouts.pairwise: All six route pairs: dot g_i^Tg_j, both norms and cosine=dot/(norm_i*norm_j)
shared_readouts.cancellation_ratio: ||mean_m g_m||^2 / mean_m ||g_m||^2, M=4; retain numerator and denominator separately
shared_readouts.zero_cases: Exactly zero pair norm -> cosine null with undefined_zero_norm; exactly zero ratio denominator -> ratio null with undefined_all_zero_norm. Keep all rows; no epsilon, clipping or survivor exclusion.
shared_readouts.unused_parameters: A None gradient contributes mathematical zero with its parameter name retained; absent dimension0 groups distinct from present groups with zero gradient

private_factor_readouts.per_route: Separate norms/squared norms and dimensions of the actual active r/s row, by every atomic group and all_private. Nonactive registered rows must have zero own-loss gradient.
private_factor_readouts.limit: Different routes own disjoint registered factor rows. Their coordinate orthogonality is an ownership fact and cannot be presented as useful gradient diversity.

single_and_I4_reference.retain: All3 M1 plus12 genuineI4 own CE losses and native/builder/private active-row gradient sizes, with dimensions and missing/zero cases
single_and_I4_reference.interpretation: Own-loss and gradient-size references only. Independent learned bodies have no asserted coordinate alignment; no cross-body cosine or cancellation ratio.

interpretation_limits: One actual next-dropout draw at selected checkpoints; no estimate of dropout-distribution uncertainty or entire training-history conflict.

Euclidean shared-gradient cancellation is not the actual AdamW update, which uses saved moments and coordinate scaling. It does not prove harmful interference or causation of weaker validation members.
Gradient norm magnitudes and cosines depend on parameterization/scales and selected fitted states. Different group dimensions and conditional-builder parameters are reported explicitly.
A small ratio can reflect opposing directions and unequal route magnitudes; inspect all pairwise dots/cosines and norms rather than naming every small ratio harmful conflict.
No update, retraining, validation predictive benefit, causal proof, new unused confirmation, automatic new fit or reviewer follows from this diagnostic.
whole_roster_gate: Only COMPLETE15banks/24restores/51backwards produces complete diagnostic. Any failed/nonfinite/timeout block retained alongside complete and unstarted rows; no retry, replacement, survivor mean or automatic continuation.
external_owner: Root binds finite240s-or-shorter owner with actual termination/exit/reap. Internal alarm and peak allocated CUDA/lifetime RSS checks supplement the external owner.

access_scope.metadata: COMPLETE_FAMILY/checkpoint deserialization may incidentally carry stored score fields; only closure,identity,selected-step and receipt fields are used. No VALID label/archive deserialization or score recomputation.

entrypoint: diagnose.py --admission <actual exact root JSON> --output <fresh allocation phase directory>
